

# Alternate Ordering

```{r}
save_rds_path <- 'C:/Users/DBT3KD/Desktop/Etude_macro_elec/prix_electricite_gitlab/VAR_analysis_fr/VAR_output/plot_irfs_rds'
setwd(save_rds_path)
irf_cholesky_esp_spot_first <- readRDS("irf_cholesky_esp_spot_first.rds")



save_rds_path <- 'C:/Users/DBT3KD/Desktop/Etude_macro_elec/prix_electricite_gitlab/VAR_analysis_fr/VAR_output/plot_irfs_rds'
setwd(save_rds_path)
gen_benchmark_esp_spot_first <- readRDS( "gen_benchmark_esp_spot_first.rds")

```

```{r}
#Plot the IRFs
irf_price_shock_esp <- plot_irf_from_gen_benchmark(
  solution = gen_benchmark_esp_spot_first,
  irf_cholesky = irf_cholesky_esp_spot_first,
  variable_names = c('$P_{elec}$', '$Q_{elec}$',  "IPI", '$HCPI_t$'),
  shock = "price"
)
irf_price_shock_esp
```


```{r}
#Plot the IRFs

irf_gen_shock_esp <- plot_irf_from_gen_benchmark(
  solution = gen_benchmark_esp_spot_first,
  irf_cholesky = irf_cholesky_esp_spot_first,
  variable_names = c('$P_{elec}$','$Q_{elec}$', "IPI", '$HCPI_t$'),
  shock = "gen"
)
irf_gen_shock_esp
```
